spf.comment: Covers both the primary 1:2 away victory from Iquique's superior defensive and lambda profile and the 1:1 draw script suited to Recoleta's qualification needs, whereas a single call would ignore the draw incentive.

score.comment: 1:2 captures Iquique's higher scoring lambda exploiting Recoleta's 1.48 conceded rate, while 1:1 covers the 12.1% modal Poisson draw.
